You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the machine gun in the development of trench warfare during the First World
War? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the roles carried out by women as an aspect of the Allied war effort? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was economic recovery after 1923 as a reason for the lack of Nazi electoral success
by 1928? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Hitler Youth in the development of Nazi rule after 1933? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was the First World War as a cause of the March Revolution in 1917? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the introduction of the New Economic Policy (NEP) to the survival of the
Bolshevik dictatorship, 1917-24? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the First World War as a reason why Prohibition was introduced in the USA?
Explain your answer.
How significant were the ‘Hundred Days’ in dealing with the economic problems in the USA during
the Depression? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was industry to the social and economic development of Communist China by 1960?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were relations with foreign countries to the economic progress of Communist China
up to 1976? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was Afrikaner nationalism as a reason for the defeat of the United Party in 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was P W Botha in weakening white minority rule in South Africa after 1978? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was superpower involvement in shaping Arab-Israeli relations after 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were the Camp David meetings in the development of the peace process after
1973? Explain your answer. [40]
